title: Jamison 2013 lumbar anterior column units: axial compression load-displacement at 1000 ms triangular impacts (fast, not quasi-static)
condition: healthy (fluoroscopy), posterior elements removed, 50 N preload

quantity.name: axial compression force-displacement curve
quantity.definition: total axial compressive force (N, includes the 50 N preload) vs imposed axial displacement from the preloaded position (mm), loading branch of the 1000 ms (baseline) triangular displacement impact to 0.8 mm; plus the mean peak load of 5 discs at 0.2 and 0.8 mm

source.authors: Jamison D, Cannella M, Pierce EC, Marcolongo MS
source.sample: 5 lumbar anterior column units (disc + adjacent vertebral bodies, posterior elements, muscles and ligaments removed), NDRI donors; levels not reported

protocol.summary: Potted ACUs on a servohydraulic tester; preconditioning 50 cycles 50-150 N at 1 Hz; 50 N compressive preload; displacement-controlled triangular axial impacts of 0.2, 0.5 and 0.8 mm with durations 80-1000 ms (randomised, 3 s apart). The 1000 ms impact (0.8 mm reached in 0.5 s, about 1.6 mm/s) is the paper's 'baseline'. This is a FAST test, not quasi-static.
how_to_simulate: Model a lumbar disc with both vertebral bodies (posterior elements removed); fix the lower body
Apply a 50 N axial preload, then zero the displacement
Impose axial compression to 0.8 mm in 0.5 s (1.6 mm/s; use a rate-dependent / poroelastic model or note the rate)
Report total axial force at each displacement on loading
protocol.notes: The curve is one representative specimen (Fig 2 top right; which specimen is not stated). The mean peak loads (n=5) come from the Results text.

extraction.from: Fig 2 top-right panel (0.8 mm, black 1000 ms loop), Results text for mean peak loads
extraction.check_notes: Axes calibrated from tick marks (130 px / 0.1 mm, 93 px / 100 N). Loading branch = lower branch of the loop (larger force at the same displacement, starts at the 45 N preload point, ends at the 950 N peak). Sign flipped (paper plots compression as negative). Representative peak 950 N is above the 5-disc mean of 700 N.

pass_rule.rule: model force within +/-15% of the curve at the same displacement and rate
